current_source_notes: 2026 DTC activewear sources surface Satisfy Running, LSKD, MAAP, Tracksmith, Finisterre and other niche performance labels.
2026 DTC footwear sources track specialist brands including Paul Evans, Dear Frances, Sarah Flint, Lane Eight, Atoms, Brunt and others.
2026 independent streetwear sources identify labels such as Corteiz, Dime, Polar Skate Co., Nude Project, Cole Buxton and Story mfg.
Current children's fashion coverage includes independent labels such as Bobo Choses, Konges Slojd, Frugi, Organic Zoo and Polarn O. Pyret.
